name: International Court of Justice

temporal: Jurisdiction is case- and legal-basis-specific; this record does not imply retroactive competence over historical conduct.
territorial: No generic territorial jurisdiction is inferred; competence depends on the applicable jurisdictional basis.
personal: Only States may be parties in contentious cases under Article 34 of the Statute.
subject_matter: Cases referred by the parties and matters specially provided for in the UN Charter or treaties/conventions in force; other jurisdictional bases remain case-specific.

notes: Registry seed for forum competence. Presence of JUR-ICJ never proves that the Court has jurisdiction over a particular dispute.
